description: **Grow is provider-neutral and BYOK-first.** Grok models, inference endpoints, product credentials, billing paths, and xAI services are no longer built in.
**Models use explicit provider configuration.** New sessions follow `[models].default`; restored sessions keep their last model and reasoning effort.
**Multi-provider inference** supports Chat Completions, Responses, and Messages backends with provider-scoped credentials, reasoning efforts, and `output_limit`.
**Agent and Skill discovery** uses project `.grow` and user `~/.grow` only (no `~/.agent` fallback), while Agents remain independent from provider and model selection.
**Local-only product surfaces** retain announcements, diagnostics, sessions, marketplaces, and MCP integrations without remote delivery or telemetry upload.
**Default Agent prompts are readable build inputs.** Markdown under `grow-agent/prompts` is embedded directly without prompt encryption or a generated Rust wrapper.
**Provider-scoped OAuth is vendor-neutral.** No issuer, client, vendor scopes, or implicit model catalog is built in; API keys remain the default BYOK path.
**Grow protocol and local storage no longer carry upstream product remnants.** Grow ACP names use the `_grow/*` namespace and the orphaned GCS memory archive builder is removed.
**GitHub Release is the only distribution channel.** Grow 1.0.0 supports macOS arm64, Linux arm64, and Linux amd64.
